integrity.method: exact proof with independent finite-matrix and inversion computation checks

scientific_limitations: Infinite, linear, scalar nearest-neighbour chain with known positive host substrate stiffness and unchanged defect bonds.
Two exact squared mode frequencies straddling the host band are assumed; no noisy-data or finite-size stability theorem.
A general three-parameter forward impurity model in arXiv:2505.24497 covers the two-sided localization phenomenon, not attributed as novel here.
Equivalent inverse characterizations in literature cannot be excluded without independent priority verification.
title: Sharp two-frequency inverse reconstruction of a pinned-lattice mass and substrate impurity
